content.text: Historical live action. Same Gou An, same face, short moustache and beard, black headcloth, plain grey linen clothes, same empty wooden grain cart and overcast camp road as the first frame. He is relieved to be alive, in noticeably good spirits and happy to have his companion: his tense eyes soften immediately, cheeks lift into a warm unmistakable smile. 0-2 seconds: he looks back at the companion just beside the camera with a friendly grin, shoulders relaxed. 2-5 seconds: still smiling, in a bright playful Mandarin voice he says exactly “别光看着，搭把手！” It is an affectionate invitation, not an angry command. 5-8 seconds: he gives a small cheerful nod, turns toward the road and firmly places both hands on the rear rail ready to push. He stays at the LEFT rear of the cart; no walking through it or changing sides. The cart remains visibly empty with a bare wooden floor. Camera remains near the cart behind him and gently follows his natural turn, one continuous shot. Do not show the companion face or add any foreground person. No sad frown, no bowed head, no crying, no victory celebration. No titles, text, subtitles, overlays, watermarks. Only the specified line, cloth rustle and light wind; no music.
